newsitem.title: USA: HFS transfers insurance unit to Aon.
newsitem.headline: HFS transfers insurance unit to Aon.

text.p: HFS Inc said on Tuesday it has transferred its ERA errors-and-omissions insurance business to Aon Corp and signed a seven-year preferred vendor program for Aon Risk Services to provide the insurance to HFS's real estate brands.
HFS expects its real estate franchisees to benefit from Aon Risk's expertise as HFS-affiliated brokerages will get special service and rates, the company said.
Errors-and-omissions insurance protects brokers and agents from exposure to losses caused by inadvertent failure to disclose potential liabilities at the time of closing, HFS said.
The insurance will cover HFS's ERA, Century 21 and Coldwell Banker brands, HFS said.
